entries.3fbbfc052db4b40c: A reportable segment that sells eyeglasses and other products in Japan; its revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥49,253 million. The Domestic Business consists of the Zoff Business, which uses the SPA model, and the Megane Super Business.
entries.5a1a8a559fafa14b: A business operated mainly under the "Megane Super" store brand. Unlike the SPA model, it mainly handles products planned and manufactured by manufacturers, and is strong in high-value-added eyewear products based on attentive customer service and in sales of contact lenses. It consists of Horus HD Co., Ltd. and 5 other companies, and Megane Super operates 299 stores nationwide (as of the end of December 2025).
entries.611bc9352ef045d3: A retail group that operates "Zoff" and "Megane Super" and sells eyeglasses and contact lenses in Japan and overseas.
entries.6565b6a2b28e3154: A reportable segment that sells eyeglasses and other products overseas; its revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥898 million. The Company, as franchise headquarters, plans and sells eyeglasses under its original brand, and overseas subsidiaries conduct retail as franchisees. There are 20 stores in total, 17 in Hong Kong and 3 in Singapore, all operated by franchisees.
entries.be2196ff73078d25: A reportable segment that sells eyeglasses and other products in Japan; its revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥49,253 million.
entries.d273dc29d316e54c: A reportable segment that sells eyeglasses and other products overseas; its revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥898 million.
entries.e4cfbeb71581dd0e: A business operated mainly under the "Megane Super" store brand.
entries.eca9b1fb4993b746: A business that, under the "Zoff" store brand, handles everything from planning to sale of eyeglasses and eyeglass accessories using the SPA model.
entries.ffb78abe82be3a7c: A business that, under the "Zoff" store brand, handles everything from planning to sale of eyeglasses and eyeglass accessories using the SPA model. It consists of the Company and its consolidated subsidiary Zoff Co., Ltd.; it has 332 stores in Japan, all operated by Zoff Co., Ltd.
